details:
I know this is a niche bug report.

Normally, if you have the Portal Prompt turned on, it will appear when you approach a portal and disappear when you move away. However, if Bounds changes from a large avatar to a small avatar while the Portal Prompt is displayed, it may persist.

Video: https://streamable.com/dvfoyi

Prerequisites:

Portal Prompt is turned on.

How to reproduce:

1. Approach a portal using a large avatar with Bounds (I used the Bounds(5,5,5) avatar. avtr_0622d170-ebd4-4312-bcb3-8127e35c361f )

2. Confirm that the Portal Prompt appears

3. Immediately change Bounds to a normal sized avatar (I used the public Runa avatar)

4. At this point, the Portal Prompt should disappear because the portal is too far away for the current avatar, but it continues to appear.

5. The Portal Prompt will continue to appear no matter where you move in the world, and you can enter the portal by interacting with it

In the video, there is an error when entering the portal, but I don't think this is related.
title: When switching avatars near a portal, the proximity detection may remain.
